package.name: ur_visual_servo_demo
package.description: Eye-in-hand position-based visual servoing (PBVS) demo for the UR10e. Continuously drives the wrist-mounted camera to a desired pose relative to a detected ArUco marker (centered, squared, at a stand-off distance), so the arm tracks the marker as it moves. Uses MoveIt /compute_ik + scaled_joint_trajectory_controller; the marker pose comes from ur_vision_demo + ur_tf_demo.
